title: Energy-space Birkhoff normal forms for smoothing polynomial Hamiltonians with strongly nonresonant low-mode frequencies and multiplicities
author: Joackim Bernier; Benoît Grébert
work: Birkhoff normal forms for Hamiltonian PDEs in their energy space
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 9 (2022), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.193
difficulty_reason: Finite-dimensional formal homological elimination does not control an infinite-dimensional Hamiltonian flow at energy regularity. Section3 proves harmonic-mean coefficient estimates and Poisson-bracket closure, including derivative bounds on both positive and negative Sobolev spaces. Section4 uses those new estimates in the degree-by-degree low-mode homological construction to obtain actual symplectic maps and a controlled remainder without demanding high-regularity initial data.
